title: Kochi Corporation ward boundaries (2022 community snapshot; partial geometry-valid subset)
publisher: DataMeet Trust, Pune chapter; README attributes source geometry to Kerala OpenSDI KSUDP_KCH_Ward_Boundary
publication_date: Not stated; dataset README says wards as of 2022
license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5 India (CC BY-SA 2.5 India), stated in dataset-specific DataMeet README; attribution and share-alike apply
geographic_coverage: Source-declared Kochi Municipal Corporation wards; observed coordinate bounds 76.2373589?76.3400293 E, 9.8934161?10.0497693 N; not checked against the invalid provisional corporation polygon
limitations: Community repackaging of a Kerala OpenSDI source; live source service and current ward register were not independently cross-checked.
Source is newline-delimited Feature objects, not one FeatureCollection; normalized copy retains feature properties and valid geometries.
Three of 77 source features self-intersect and are excluded from the processed map copy; raw source bytes remain unchanged.
Six of 77 source features have no Ward_No or Ward_Name; they remain in the processed copy, flagged as missing required attributes.
The processed subset is incomplete and not a legal/current boundary, a coverage mask, a hazard layer, or a suitable input for exposure calculations.
Source scale, positional accuracy, ward identifiers/currency, and publication date are not stated.
quality_notes: 77 source polygons; 3 self-intersecting geometries excluded after structural QA (74 remain).
6 source features lack Ward_No and Ward_Name; attributes remain missing and were not inferred.
No verified current corporation boundary was available to compare completeness or clip coverage.
crs_note: WGS 84 longitude/latitude per GeoJSON RFC 7946 semantics; no explicit CRS member is embedded in this source file.
